cases.note: The shared application boundary converts a deny decision into a policy error before execution.
The HTTP middleware denies the governed route before the canonical run command executor.
MCP tool dispatch is behind the same boundary and does not call the repository on deny.
A denied run work item is dead-lettered before lease acquisition or handler execution.

known_limitations: Grant loading and policy decision persistence are not durable PostgreSQL runtime behavior in G2.
Delegation attenuation, bounded delegation depth, hierarchical budgets, approval override semantics, and federation adapters remain later gates.
The generic job poller has no trusted workspace/principal context and remains orchestration-only; the governed run worker is the worker evidence path.
This fixture is evidence-only and does not claim a qualified GOVERNANCE profile or full qualification bundle.
